Full release notes: **https://danbyte.net/news/v0-11-1**

### Highlights

- **Device photo builder** — the "Auto-fill a run" tool now lays ports in **1–4 rows**, groups them into **banks** (by port count, with presets or a custom size), spaces those banks with an adjustable gap, and supports **optional per-row Y** for panels whose rows aren't evenly aligned.
- **Schematic faceplate** — auto-arrange now covers **every port kind** (interfaces, front/rear ports, console, power, aux) instead of interfaces only, with per-group row/bank and spacing controls.
- **Combo / shared ports** — model a shared port with more than one connector (an RJ45 and its SFP twin, dual management jacks) via a **combo group**; enabling one connector automatically disables the others, and SNMP drift keeps the pair in sync.
- **Device overview** — one consolidated **Panel** (Photo / Rendered / Bare + Front/Rear) pinned to the top of the page, replacing the redundant rack-face image card.

Install and upgrade as usual — migrations apply automatically. Upgrading from 0.11.0 is supported in place.
